headline.purpose: One Prata title per screen, top left.

title.purpose: Prata section titles in sheets and lists.

title-card.purpose: Heading of a settings or form card.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, explanations and input text (16px so iOS does not zoom).

meta.purpose: Counts, dates and places in graphite. Never below 12px.

label-small.purpose: Text-only actions such as See all and Adjust fit.

tag.purpose: Caveat for storage places, outfit names and notes.

stamp.purpose: Caveat for finished states: packed, worn, done.

shadows.name: paper-rest
shadows.purpose: Every card, slot, round icon button and the search bar.

shadows.name: paper-lifted
shadows.purpose: Selected or on-top pieces; garment cards also rise 3px.

shadows.name: bottom-sheet
shadows.purpose: Sheets that slide up, paired with the curled top edge.

shadows.name: tab-add
shadows.purpose: Centre + cut out of the tab bar by a white ring.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Every paper animation (garment flutter, sheet curl, tab slip, scissor trace, tag pin) is replaced by a plain fade or no motion. Durations are not decided yet.

textures.name: crumple
textures.value: <filter><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.012 0.017" numOctaves="4"/><feDiffuseLighting lighting-color="#ffffff" surfaceScale="2.4" diffuseConstant="1.08"><feDistantLight azimuth="225" elevation="40"/></feDiffuseLighting></filter>
textures.purpose: Crumpled paper ground, mix-blend-mode multiply at about 0.55 opacity. The only gradient-like effect.

shapes.name: luggage-tag
shapes.purpose: Square eyelet end, round far end, with a small eyelet circle.

shapes.name: curled-edge
shapes.purpose: Top edge of a sliding sheet, 12px tall, drawn in the sheet colour.

focus.purpose: Visible focus on every interactive element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink button for the main action on a screen or sheet.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 4h12v17l-6-4-6 4Z"/></svg>Save outfit</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: #141414; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 1px 2px 4px rgba(20,20,20,.25); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 2px 4px 8px rgba(20,20,20,.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White button with an ink border for the second action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1.5px solid #141414; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #141414; font: 600 16px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F6F4EF; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Tissue choice chips; selected turns ink. The star marks an AI-suggested value.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #F6F4EF; color: #141414; font: 500 14.5px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #EEECE7; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #141414; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Tissue-filled field with the label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; font: 500 14px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #141414; } .ds-field input { height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #F6F4EF; padding: 0 14px; font: 400 16px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #141414; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #55524C; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Four tabs with a raised centre + for adding clothes (D29).
components.html: Dress-upWardrobeOutfitsTrips
components.css: .ds-tabs { width: 390px; height: 84px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 -2px 10px rgba(20,20,20,.05); display: flex; justify-content: space-around; padding-top: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font: 500 12px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #55524C; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabs a:hover { color: #141414; } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-ic { width: 52px; height: 30px; border-radius: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #141414; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: #141414; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current="page"] .ds-tab-ic { background: #141414; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-tabs .ds-tab-add { flex: none; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-top: -13px; border-radius: 50%; background: #141414; color: #FFFFFF; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #FFFFFF, 1px 5px 12px rgba(20,20,20,.3); }

components.name: Cut-out Card
components.description: White paper card on the crumpled ground; lifts when selected.
components.css: .ds-ground { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; background: #EEECE7; } .ds-card { width: 150px; height: 76px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #55524C; font: 400 14px 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(20,20,20,.07), 1px 2px 3px rgba(20,20,20,.14); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-card[aria-pressed="true"] { transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-0.6deg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(20,20,20,.08), 2px 6px 12px rgba(20,20,20,.18); color: #141414; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Slot with Callout
components.description: Dress-up slot card joined to its body part by a dashed callout leader (D31).
components.css: .ds-slot-wrap { position: relative; width: 250px; height: 62px; } .ds-slot-wrap svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-slot { position: absolute; left: 110px; top: 8px; width: 140px; height: 46px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(20,20,20,.07), 1px 2px 3px rgba(20,20,20,.14); padding: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slot:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(20,20,20,.08), 2px 6px 12px rgba(20,20,20,.18); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slot-well { width: 34px; height: 30px; border-radius: 4px; background: #F6F4EF; flex: none; } .ds-slot-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: 'Onest', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #141414; } .ds-slot-text span { font-size: 12px; color: #55524C; } .ds-slot-text strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Luggage Tag and Stamp
components.description: Caveat paper devices: a tag for places and outfit names, a stamp for finished states.
components.html: under the bedpacked
components.css: .ds-devices { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 16px; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px 0 9px; border: 1.5px solid #141414; border-radius: 3px 15px 15px 3px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #141414; font: 600 20px 'Caveat', cursive; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-eyelet { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #141414; } .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid #141414; border-radius: 6px; color: #141414; font: 700 22px 'Caveat', cursive; opacity: .85; transform: rotate(-8deg); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Settings switch, 52 x 32, ink when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; background: #8F8A80; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,.25); transition: left .2s; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: #141414; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] span { left: 24px; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The mannequin is you. Everything else is paper and ink: a crumpled paper page, white cut-out cards, black ink for text and actions. The clothes are the only colour on screen (D27). Garments are cut-outs with a white scissor margin, so they read as pieces you can pick up and put on.

The world is calm and tactile, not cute. Titles are set in Prata, a high-contrast serif (D28). Text is Onest. Handwriting, in Caveat, appears only where a person would write by hand: tags on storage places and outfits, stamps, notes. Screens are dense but quiet, built for one thumb while standing (PRODUCT.md, principle 4).
keyCharacteristics: Crumpled paper ground with white cut-out cards that cast soft offset shadows.
Ink and graphite only; the clothes carry all the colour.
Prata titles, Onest text, Caveat for hand-written tags and stamps.
Paper devices with meaning: luggage tags, rubber stamps, the pen circle, dashed callout lines.
Dress-up shows every slot at once, each joined to its body part (D31).

rules.name: The Clothes Are the Colour Rule
rules.body: No hue appears in the UI except a garment's own colour and the marker red for errors. Swatches inside colour chips are garment colours, so they count as clothes.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Marker red is never decoration. If nothing is wrong or being deleted, there is no red on screen.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 12px. The only exception is the favicon-size logo tile, which is an image.

rules.name: The Pen Only Writes Rule
rules.body: Caveat is for words a person would write by hand: places, outfit names, stamps, notes. Never for buttons, titles, body text or numbers you need to read precisely.

rules.name: The Never Over the Body Rule
rules.body: Nothing covers the mannequin on Dress-up. Sheets stop at its feet.

rules.name: The Soft Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper shadows are offset and blurred. No hard, zero-blur block shadows.

rules.name: The Lift Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: The lifted shadow means "selected" or "on top". Never use it for decoration.

dos: Do keep the UI in ink, graphite and paper; let the garments be the colour.
Do use the paper-at-rest shadow on every card and the lifted shadow only for selected pieces.
Do show every Dress-up slot at once, each joined to its body part by a callout line (D31).
Do open the clothes row below the mannequin.
Do give every garment a white scissor margin and a drop shadow.
Do mark pre-filled values with the AI star and keep them editable (R5).
Do use only drawn garments and an outline or stand-in mannequin in the repo and its screenshots (R2).
donts: Don't use hard, zero-blur offset shadows.
Don't put an eyebrow or small label above a heading, or use tracked uppercase labels.
Don't write progress as text ("Step 2 of 3"); show it with bars or dots.
Don't use gradients other than the crumple texture, glass effects, or icons in tinted squares.
Don't use marker red for anything but errors and delete.
Don't set Caveat for buttons, titles or body text.
Don't cover the mannequin with a sheet or menu.
